tasks.short: Organise and direct study abroad programmes

steps.what: Agree study abroad requirements with students and host contacts and verify arrangements
Compile programme schedules, participant lists and information packs
Check and share arrangements, direct the programme and resolve participant issues

tasks.design: Configure programme records in {PROJECT} and pack templates in {DOCS}. The lecturer agrees arrangements, checks the final pack and retains programme direction and support for students.
tasks.previous_blocker: Agreed arrangements are copied into multiple schedules and packs.
tasks.enabler_now: Structured programme records can populate repeated document sections.
tasks.still_hard: Handling changed host arrangements and individual participant needs.
tasks.human_edge: Coordinate people and respond to unexpected situations abroad.
tasks.altitude: Less pack assembly; programme judgment and direction remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Keep confirmed arrangements distinct from proposals

evidence.claim: Configured programme packs are a model knowledge proposal; no supplied case measures study abroad coordination savings.

assumptions: Boundary is lecturer programme organisation and direction, excluding travel agency bookings, host delivery and institutional travel approval.

Lecturer captures programme id, dates, participant ids, verified contacts, confirmed host activities, meeting locations, deadlines and source confirmations during s1. All collection and capture remain counted; missing confirmations remain pending and require manual follow-up.
Hosts and students provide their existing responses; six other-role incremental hours below cover extra structured entry and support rather than assuming free data.
Test native PROJECT records and DOCS templates first. No automatic travel eligibility, risk clearance or readiness flag; participant issues arise during s3 and remain human.
unknowns: Programme scope, existing records and sensitive information handling
research_questions: Can a single arrangement record reduce pack assembly without increasing host or student updates?

already_counted.description: Agreement, source confirmation and field capture
Pack check, communication and programme direction

incremental.description: Maintain programme fields and resolve stale arrangements
Additional structured entry and configuration support

approvals.approved_version: Exact participant list, confirmed arrangement snapshot and pack version; changes require recheck before sharing

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R70 gives30 gross minus8 upkeep=22 net. One-off arrangements may remain manual; repeated pack assembly may yield5%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in recruitment, registration and placement

steps.what: Discuss student recruitment, registration and placement needs and confirm requested activities
Prepare registration and placement participation records from the verified details
Check and accept the student participation record

tasks.design: Use native activity forms in the {OTHER} student registry to prepare records without repeated entry. Recruitment interaction and placement guidance remain with the lecturer; the record does not decide admission or placement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Conversation details can be copied into separate participation records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms and mappings can reuse verified details.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding language goals and resolving ambiguous requests.
tasks.human_edge: Explain options and respond to the student's circumstances.
tasks.altitude: Less record preparation; student-facing work remains unchanged.

reach.learn: Separate student preference from formal decisions

evidence.claim: Configured registry records are plausible; this lecturer activity has no supplied measured case.

assumptions: Boundary is lecturer participation and records, excluding admissions, employer decisions and registry staff work.

Lecturer captures student id, programme/language, term, activity type, request status and source confirmation during s1. Capture remains counted; missing identifiers require manual clarification, not inferred eligibility.
OTHER means student registry. Test native forms first; existing automated entry earns no saving.
No language proficiency or placement suitability score is produced automatically.
unknowns: Current participation records and lecturer authority
research_questions: Can native records remove duplicate entry without changing placement decisions?

approvals.approved_version: Exact student, programme, term, activity and request snapshot; changes void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gives20 gross minus6 upkeep=14 net. Existing integrated records yield zero; repeated manual record preparation may yield3%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select specialized materials and verify editions for outside reading assignments
Compile bibliographies in the required citation style and order
Check references, reading suitability and accept the bibliography

tasks.design: Configure citation styles and list exports in the {OTHER} reference manager. The lecturer chooses appropriate reading, verifies exact editions and checks the resulting bibliography in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Bibliographic formatting repeats facts already held in catalogue records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference exports can format verified entries consistently.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting the correct translation or edition for the students' needs.
tasks.human_edge: Choose readings for linguistic level and scholarly relevance.
tasks.altitude: Less citation formatting; reading selection remains human.

reach.learn: Distinguish editions, translations and access versions

evidence.claim: Reference-manager bibliography formatting is model knowledge; no supplied case measures this task's savings.

assumptions: Boundary is bibliography preparation, excluding acquiring readings and teaching them.

Lecturer captures verified author, title, year, edition/translation, publisher, pages, catalogue identifier or DOI, access link, reading order and citation style during s1. Verification and metadata correction retain45%; missing facts require catalogue lookup or manual entry, never generated references.
OTHER means reference manager and library catalogue. Test native exports and styles first; existing automatic formatting earns no additional saving.
No model is needed for citation formatting or reading suitability decisions.
unknowns: Metadata quality and current reference manager use
research_questions: Can the native export preserve exact edition and translation information without extra correction?

incremental.description: Maintain citation style and repair changed metadata mappings
Maintain catalogue access and reference software

approvals.approved_version: Exact selected records, editions, citation style and bibliography version; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R65 gives35 gross minus6 upkeep=29 net. Existing reference exports yield zero; repeated manual bibliography formatting may yield7%.

tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events

steps.what: Participate in campus and community events and engage attendees in language and culture

tasks.design: Retain the lecturer's presence and interaction with attendees. {CALENDAR} details support attendance but do not replace community engagement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Participation depends on direct interaction and responsive explanation.
tasks.enabler_now: No verified replacement for live engagement is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Responding respectfully to different language experiences and cultural interests.

evidence.claim: Event record automation does not establish replacement of the lecturer's public participation.

assumptions: Boundary is participation, excluding organiser logistics and recruitment records counted separately.
Attendees produce questions during s1; no structured interest or engagement flag is assumed.
Test current calendar support before additions; no tool change is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no new system or process is introduced.
unknowns: Event format and expected lecturer contribution
research_questions: Which conversations depend on the lecturer's cultural and linguistic knowledge?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives zero gross and net; campus and community events both retain live participation.
